 Follow Us On Google EXCLUSIVE: Tennis Star Taylor Fritz Lists Miami Condo With Private Balcony and Tennis Court Access for $860K
 By Kelsi Karruli 
 October 23, 2026 
 Julian Finney/Getty Images for Laver Cup Tennis star Taylor Fritz is serving up his Miami condo for $860,000, offering a buyer the chance to score a corner residence with sweeping views—and a tennis court just downstairs.
 The two-bedroom, two-bathroom property is located at Hyde Midtown, where an extensive collection of shared amenities includes everything from a swimming pool to spaces for games, fitness, and dining.
 Spanning 1,096 square feet, the residence combines an open living area with a wraparound balcony overlooking the Miami skyline and Biscayne Bay, according to the listing, which is held by Elaine Atkins of Coldwell Banker Realty.
 Fritz purchased the property for $845,000 in March 2023. His current asking price is $15,000 above that purchase amount, a difference of approximately 1.8%, before accounting for any ownership expenses or selling costs.

Realtor.com Inside, the condo’s corner position provides eastern and southern exposures, with floor-to-ceiling impact glass framing the surrounding scenery.
 The glass-lined living spaces connect to the balcony, extending the home’s entertaining options outdoors. 
 The wraparound configuration also allows the views to become a defining feature of the residence, rather than something reserved for a single room.
 An open layout brings the kitchen, dining, and living areas together, keeping the main gathering spaces connected.
 The kitchen features European styling, with flat-front cabinets, integrated appliances, and lighting beneath the cabinetry. An island provides additional workspace alongside seating for casual meals.
 For buyers who enjoy hosting, that arrangement allows conversation to continue between the kitchen and the adjoining living and dining areas.
 The primary bedroom has its own access to the balcony, giving the suite a direct connection to the outdoor space.
 A walk-in closet includes custom fittings, while the attached bathroom features two vessel sinks and a glass-enclosed shower.
 The second bedroom and bathroom sit on the other side of the residence, creating separation between the sleeping quarters. That layout offers privacy for guests or anyone sharing the home.
 A washer and dryer inside the unit round out the practical features.

"It's surrounded by premier shopping and dining, steps from the Design District and Wynwood, with quick access to Miami Beach and MIA," the listing reads. Realtor.com The property dates to 2018, and the listing also identifies one garage space. Monthly homeowners association fees are listed at $1,820.
 Beyond the apartment itself, Hyde Midtown offers a lengthy roster of recreational facilities.
 For Fritz, the most fitting feature is the building’s tennis court, giving the next owner access to the same sport that made the seller famous.
 Residents also have access to a fitness center, pool, spa, and Jacuzzi, along with media and game rooms and private club spaces.
 A children’s room and dog park add to the communal offerings, while on-site dining provides another option close to home.
 Building services include valet parking, round-the-clock security, and a separate residential entrance.
 The listing also highlights the property’s proximity to the Design District and Wynwood, placing shopping, restaurants, and cultural destinations within the surrounding area.
 "It's surrounded by premier shopping and dining, steps from the Design District and Wynwood, with quick access to Miami Beach and MIA," the listing reads.
 For prospective purchasers considering rental use, the marketing materials state that rentals of at least 30 days are permitted up to 12 times annually.
 Fritz’s ownership began before one of the biggest milestones of his tennis career.
 In September 2024, he reached his first Grand Slam singles final at the U.S. Open after defeating fellow American Frances Tiafoe in a five-set semifinal. He ultimately lost the championship match to Jannik Sinner . 
 Now, his Miami residence offers its next owner a place to unwind between matches—with room to practice their own serve.
 Kelsi Karruli is a senior celebrity reporter who joined Realtor.com in 2025. She writes about trends encompassing real estate and celebrity properties. She previously wrote for Daily Mail, True Urban Culture, and JMedia Corporation, where she specialized in covering celebrities, relationships, psychology, and gender issues. She has a bachelor's degree in journalism from Pace University, where she received the James Rose Award for excellence in journalism. When she isn’t updating readers on A-listers' moves, she is spending time with her cat, Mary, and cheering on the Albanian soccer team.
